<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the protected alcohol (TMS ether), gives the alcohol precursor. The target molecule is likely a TMS ether such as CC[Si](C)(C)C (ethyl TMS ether). We'll search the template catalog for templates that break an O-H bond (in the forward direction) and form an O-Si bond, with the broken functional group being aliphatic hydroxyls.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC[Si](C)(C)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": ["O-Si"],
    "bonds_broken": ["O-H"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
